panels.description: At a Halyard junction, Alex and B11 face an uphill route marked OASIS REVIEW while TJ stands at their feet. Leave upper route space.
Alex's identity band displays a conditional convenor pass and pending collaborator access. Keep the screen unobstructed.
B11 points uphill while Alex looks toward the conditional route. Keep the brass ring around B11's right eye visible and leave upper space.
Behind the barrier, Ada uses the access tool on a concealed service passage. Keep her own action separate from Alex's route and leave upper wall space.
